repositories.name: SingLink Protocol
repositories.summary: First-generation version of the SingLink protocol, written from scratch: signed device-bound access passes, inner end-to-end encryption, hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 post-quantum key exchange, replay and active-probe resistance
repositories.securityReview: Internal security audit: 31 findings, all High and Medium fixed; third-party audit planned

repositories.name: SingLinkVPN first-generation client
repositories.summary: First-generation SingLinkVPN client built on the SingLink Protocol: device-wide VPN on mobile, system proxy on desktop

openSource.lineage: The SingLink protocol has evolved from SingLinkVPN's early versions to today's SingLink 2.0. The open-source first-generation SingLink protocol and first-generation SingLinkVPN client carry forward SingLinkVPN's long-standing design principles (account-based permissions, device binding and security by design) and were released after a security audit. The official apps and protocol have since moved to a new-generation architecture that is not yet fully public for security reasons; only code that poses no security risk was released, and the open-source plan will continue.
openSource.closedSourceReason: The latest versions are not yet fully public for security reasons; only code that poses no security risk was released

technology.status: Core development and first-phase testing completed; protocol security and implementation review in progress
